data.name: Bharat
data.gender_notes: Bharat is used as a male name in hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: From the Sanskrit root bhṛ, 'to bear, support' — Bharata, 'the sustainer'. Its root is Sanskrit bhṛ (भृ). Bharata, brother of Rama; also an ancient emperor. Bharat is a Sanskrit name meaning “Maintained; the sustainer; India”. Families who choose it generally do so for the quality the name expresses.
data.spiritual_meaning: Bharat expresses “Maintained; the sustainer; India”; spiritual readings of the name are interpretive.
data.etymology: From the Sanskrit root bhṛ, 'to bear, support' — Bharata, 'the sustainer'.
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Bharat total 23, reducing to 5. Number 5 is associated with freedom, adaptability and curiosity.
